evidence.source:
<div className="cs-cal__grid" role="grid" aria-labelledby={monthId} onKeyDown={(e) => {
        const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-day]");
        if (!btn) return;
        const cur = Number(btn.getAttribute("data-day"));
        let next = null;
        if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") next = localDate(y, m, cur - 1);
        else if (e.key === "ArrowRight") next = localDate(y, m, cur + 1);
        else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") next = localDate(y, m, cur - 7);
        else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") next = localDate(y, m, cur + 7);
        // Keep the established month-boundary Home/End contract.
        else if (e.key === "Home") next = localDate(y, m, 1);
        else if (e.key === "End") next = localDate(y, m, maxDay);
        else if (e.key === "PageUp" || e.key === "PageDown") {
          const offset = (e.key === "PageUp" ? -1 : 1) * (e.shiftKey ? 12 : 1);
          const target = localDate(y, m + offset, 1);
          next = localDate(target.getFullYear(), target.getMonth(), Math.min(cur, localDate(target.getFullYear(), target.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate()));
        }
        if (next) {
          e.preventDefault();
          moveFocus(next);
        }
      }}>

<input aria-labelledby={control["aria-labelledby"] ? control["aria-labelledby"] + " " + control.id + "-digit-" + (i + 1) : undefined} id={control.id + "-" + (i + 1)} aria-describedby={control["aria-describedby"]} aria-invalid={control["aria-invalid"]} ref={(el) => (boxes.current[i] = el)} inputMode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]*" maxLength={1} disabled={disabled}
          value={val[i] || ""} aria-label={(control["aria-label"] || lbl) + " " + (i + 1) + "/" + length}
          onChange={(e) => {
            // Native Delete/cut/clear produces an empty input, unlike invalid text.
            if (e.target.value === "") { set(val.slice(0, i) + val.slice(i + 1)); return; }
            const c = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "");
            if (!c) return;
            set(val.slice(0, i) + c + val.slice(i + 1));
            const nb = boxes.current[i + 1]; if (nb) nb.focus();
          }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229 || e.key !== "Backspace") return;
            e.preventDefault();
            const arr = val.split("");
            if (arr[i]) arr.splice(i, 1); else if (i > 0) arr.splice(i - 1, 1);
            set(arr.join(""));
            const pb = boxes.current[Math.max(0, i - 1)]; if (pb) pb.focus();
          }}
          onPaste={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const p = (e.clipboardData.getData("text") || "").replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, length);
            set(p);
            const nb = boxes.current[Math.min(length - 1, p.length)]; if (nb) nb.focus();
          }}
        />

evidence.source:
<div
          ref={mergedNativeRef}
          className={cx("cs-menu__list", align === "end" && "cs-menu__list--end")}
          role="menu"
          aria-label={t("menu")}
          onFocus={(event) => {
            const item = event.target.closest?.('[role="menuitem"]');
            if (item) for (const option of enabledItems()) option.tabIndex = option === item ? 0 : -1;
          }}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.defaultPrevented || event.nativeEvent.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229 || event.key !== "Tab") return;
            // Focus the next external control before removing the focused item.
            // Firefox can otherwise restore the trigger after native Tab runs.
            // A parent modal retains ownership of the candidate focus scope.
            const modal = manager.activeModal();
            const roots = modal ? manager.focusScope() : [document.body];
            let options = [...new Set(roots.flatMap(root => [...root.querySelectorAll(focusableSelector)]))].filter(el =>
              el.tabIndex >= 0 && !el.disabled && !el.matches(":disabled") && !listRef.current?.contains(el) &&
              !el.closest('[inert], [hidden], [aria-hidden="true"]') && el.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== "hidden");
            // Sequential focus visits positive tabindex values first, then
            // tabindex0 controls in DOM order. Named radio groups are one stop.
            options.sort((a, b) => (a.tabIndex > 0 ? a.tabIndex : Infinity) - (b.tabIndex > 0 ? b.tabIndex : Infinity));
            options = options.filter(el => {
              if (el.tagName !== "INPUT" || el.type !== "radio" || !el.name) return true;
              const group = options.filter(other => other.tagName === "INPUT" && other.type === "radio" && other.name === el.name && other.form === el.form && other.getRootNode() === el.getRootNode());
              return el === (group.find(radio => radio.checked) || (event.shiftKey ? group.at(-1) : group[0]));
            });
            const triggerElement = triggerRef.current || ref.current?.querySelector('[aria-haspopup="menu"]');
            const index = options.indexOf(triggerElement);
            const next = index + (event.shiftKey ? -1 : 1);
            const target = options[next] || (modal ? options[(next + options.length) % options.length] : null);
            if (target) { event.preventDefault(); target.focus(); }
            else {
              // At the document edge, let the browser reach its own chrome.
              for (const option of enabledItems()) option.tabIndex = -1;
              triggerElement?.focus();
            }
            set(false);
          }}
          onClick={(e) => {
            if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
            const item = e.target.closest?.('[role="menuitem"]:not([disabled])');
            if (item && listRef.current?.contains(item)) set(false);
          }}
        >

              else return;
              e.preventDefault(); items[next]?.focus();
            }}>
